location_description:
Bliss Corner is a census-designated place (CDP) in the town of Dartmouth in Bristol County, Massachusetts, United States.  The population was 5,280 at the 2010 census.


== Geography ==
Bliss Corner is located at 41°36′23″N 70°56′31″W (41.606464, -70.941827).According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 5.2 km2 (2.0 mi2), all land.
